name: ptyper3-par1-serialorder-typer
description: The one-worker path doing the serial typer's work in the serial typer's order (`-Dscalac.parallelTyper.order=source`, `lazySignatures`, `noForceLazyVals`, with which the spike reports pickles byte-identical to serial on the library), re2s stopped after the typer, paired within each fork: `par1` against `spike` is the cost of the concurrent implementations and the parallel driver alone. xctrace counts the benchmark thread only: compare the `-Yparallel-typer` variants by time.

variantDescriptions.spike: the parallel typer spike at `3c72e64ddf`, without `-Yparallel-typer`
variantDescriptions.aa: the first variant's build again, in its own class loader: the A/A
